source_support.reason: Selected reported earnings, returns, holdings and policy disclosures trace to saved sources, but the rejected Director comparative-upside statement contradicts its grids; no accepted final report exists. This is a targeted artifact audit, not independent certification of every source.

valuation_rationale.reason: EPS and multiple assumptions are labeled but not adequately derived. MU FY2026 EPS 35/45/55 is not reconciled with reported nine-month EPS 41.40 or archived Q4 guidance 30.73 ±1.00. A lower full-year EPS is not mathematically impossible, but requires an explicit remaining-period/share-basis mechanism. Multiples 18/22/26 and 25/30/35 lack an anchor beyond generic compression/premium language. No automatic addition or annualization of per-share periods is justified.

comparison.reason: Director relative_preference for MU says stronger conditional scenario upside, yet MU bull upside is 40.78% versus NVDA 65.34%. It also does not establish a supported common expectations comparison across companies and QQQ. The rejected candidate cannot count as a delivered comparison.

downside.reason: Company identifies concentration, overseas supply, policy and memory-cycle mechanisms and computes conditional downside. Magnitudes depend on inadequately justified EPS/multiple choices and no quantified operating bridge is provided.

change_conditions.reason: Issuer-specific earnings/capex/policy and QQQ holdings review events are identified, but generic material deterioration/moderation wording is not tied to the scenario assumptions or the already available earnings guidance.

uncertainty_scope.reason: Accepted Company findings and the rejected Director candidate preserve reported business/market observations and explicitly conditional valuation; policy missingness does not cause blanket abstention or fabricated current law. Director dependencies include policy where it claims it matters. Structural claim-scope errors remain a separate delivery failure.

critical_defects.reason: No accepted Director report: six claim/dimension/instrument reference inconsistencies were found in the rejected candidate. Validation blocked it, then input admission prevented a correction. Required final delivery failed.

Required valuation rationale remains unfulfilled: scenario assumptions lack a reconciled earnings/guidance bridge and a defensible multiple anchor. Labeling numbers hypothetical is insufficient under the registered rubric.

Material comparative numerical claim in the unaccepted Director candidate is reversed: MU is described as having stronger conditional scenario upside, while the stored bull sensitivities are MU 40.78% and NVDA 65.34%. This was never published.

other_defects.reason: Context and admission bottleneck: 24 document-section records occupy 51,744 bytes in the final request evidence projection; the 184,823-byte Director request grows with a 17,365-byte rejected-output history. Four calls remain, but the conservative bytes-plus-consumed-tokens admission bound blocks further work. This is not observed exhaustion of the actual 350,000-token ceiling.

Relevant MU outlook starts after the compact opening excerpt. The archived EPS guidance is at normalized offset 3203, while the worker sees 1,600 excerpt characters by default and Company used no inspection calls. Guidance was available through inspection but not visible in the default excerpt.

The rejected Director repeats the Company scenarios without independently reconciling their assumptions or checking the comparative-upside wording; absent Challenger is an evaluation-profile exclusion, not evidence that the full team would catch this.
